UnitAbilities.Text: While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

UnitAbilities.Title: Termite Assault
UnitAbilities.Text:
- This unit must start the battle in strategic reserves.
- In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.
- When this unit is set up, all units embarked within this unit must make a disembark/assault disembark move, and those units must be set up more than 8" away from all enemy units.

UnitAbilities.Title: Transport
UnitAbilities.Text: This model has a transport capacity of 12 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. It cannot transport Gravis, Jump Pack, Terminator or Centurion models.

UnitAbilities.Title: Sunderer of Fortresses
UnitAbilities.Text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE, improve the Strength and Damage characteristic of that attack by 1 (if that attack targets a FORTIFICATION unit, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack by 2 instead).

UnitAbilities.Title: Damaged: 1-6 wounds remaining
UnitAbilities.Text: While this model has 1-6 wounds remaining, each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
